title: HOOMD-metal: HOOMD-blue molecular dynamics on Apple silicon GPUs
description:
HOOMD-metal adds a Metal GPU backend to HOOMD-blue so that HOOMD-blue molecular dynamics simulations run on the GPU of Apple silicon Macs with unchanged Python scripts. HOOMD-metal is an independent project, not developed or endorsed by the HOOMD-blue team. HOOMD-blue's code remains under the BSD 3-Clause License; the new HOOMD-metal code is also available under the MIT License (see LICENSE-MIT).

If you use HOOMD-metal in published work, please also cite HOOMD-blue: J. A. Anderson, J. Glaser, and S. C. Glotzer, Computational Materials Science 173, 109363 (2020).
